binary_byte_formatter.why: a rendering concern, not a contract, and the fit calculator that wrote it needs it in the same sentence as a refusal. Kept out of planner/comm.py on purpose: that one formats transfer volumes beside decimal GB/s bandwidths and is right to stay decimal

default_agent_port.why: the node agent's own default, read by everything that dials one

default_coordinator_port.why: the coordinator's own default, same reason

deployment_serving_states.why: same as the terminal set: derived from the enum, enforced by the fsm

deployment_terminal_states.why: a judgement about DeploymentState rather than part of it, and it belongs beside the transition table that enforces it. The gateway cannot import it -- the deploy package __init__ pulls the manager, the sparkrun adapter and the event bus into a request module -- so gateway/states.py holds the gateway's one spelling and this holds the two together

derate_key_pattern.why: the key format belongs to the keys package; redaction.py may import nothing from it (every node, including the worker path, imports the scrubber), so it holds a copy of the pattern it scrubs by. ui/src/api/redact.ts KEY_PATTERN is a third, TypeScript, copy

login_lock_username_cap.why: a policy about the lockout rather than a shape: anyone can type a username, so the bare-username lock is a denial of service on the real admin and is capped short. auth/service.py enforces it; the auth README and the forensics runbook state the number

node_roles.why: the role a node takes is the registry's question to answer

redacted_placeholder.why: it belongs with the scrubber that writes it, and that scrubber is no longer inside the provider package -- logfiles.py redacts on every node, and the worker path may not import providers

request_record_fields.why: the record is a dataclass in telemetry/, the column list is a contract the archive schema, the usage API and the UI read

runtime_names.why: the launcher owns which runtimes exist, because a runtime without a RuntimeSpec cannot be launched whatever else claims to know it

DERATE_AGENT_PORT.note: the node agent's port; docker/placeholder_app.py defaults it to DERATE_PORT instead, which is a fork only reachable by running that file directly

DERATE_ALLOW_BRIDGE.note: the container refuses bridge networking unless this is set

DERATE_API_TOKEN.note: opt-in bearer token gating /api (see gateway/auth.py); unset is a no-op

DERATE_AUDIT_LOG_DAYS.note: days of logs/audit/*.jsonl kept on disk

DERATE_AUDIT_SINK.note: remote copy of every audit row: udp://host:port or tcp://host:port (RFC 5424 syslog), http(s)://... (NDJSON POST); empty = no remote copy

DERATE_AUDIT_SINK_TOKEN.note: bearer token sent to an http(s) audit sink; never rendered

DERATE_AUTO_ADOPT_CONTAINERS.note: 0 disables the background scan that reconstructs a deployment record for a derate-launched sparkrun container running with no matching entry in the deployment store

DERATE_AUTO_ADOPT_RUNTIMES.note: 0 disables the background scan that registers a detected external runtime (e.g. Ollama) as a provider without a human clicking Adopt; the manual POST /api/nodes/{id}/runtime route is unaffected either way

DERATE_BUILD.note: stamped into the image; absent means a source checkout

DERATE_CHECK_ADMIN_USER.note: the admin the live-API verifiers log in as; the gateway answers /api only to a session

DERATE_CHECK_API_KEY.note: a derate- key for verifiers that call /v1 directly

DERATE_CHECK_BROWSER.note: an explicit Chromium path, for a machine whose Playwright cache is somewhere the finder does not look

DERATE_CHECK_ORIGIN.note: which coordinator the live-API verifiers talk to

DERATE_CHECK_STRICT.note: 1 makes an unmet requirement a failure rather than its own column, which is the mode for a box where the coordinator is actually up

DERATE_DATA.note: SHELL ONLY. The entrypoint bridges it onto DERATE_DATA_DIR; no Python reads it. Overriding this alone moves nothing (audit defect M-17)

DERATE_DATA_DIR.note: unset: /data when writable, else the platform application-state dir

DERATE_E2E_ORIGIN.note: which coordinator the audio round trip launches real models on

DERATE_EDGE_CLIENT_HEADER.note: header naming the real client on an edge connection; a request without a valid IP in it is refused 400

DERATE_EDGE_HOST.note: address the edge socket binds; loopback when cloudflared runs on this host, the docker bridge address when it is a container

DERATE_EDGE_PORT.note: second listener for a WAN edge (cloudflared): answers /v1/** only, takes the client address from DERATE_EDGE_CLIENT_HEADER, forces https; unset = no edge socket

DERATE_ELECTRICITY_RATE.note: currency per kWh; 0 means the spend screen shows no power cost

DERATE_GALLERY_ONLY.note: comma-separated component names; run.mjs sets it to scope the gallery layout matrix to the components a ui:check path names

DERATE_GATEWAY.note: dev server only: which coordinator `npm run dev` proxies to

DERATE_HOST_RESERVE_MIB.note: how much unified memory to leave the OS on a GB10

DERATE_IMAGE_DIGEST.note: the sha256 digest this node's image was installed by; install.sh --digest sets it, and the join command then pins it

DERATE_INSTALL_SH.note: override the installer script the coordinator serves

DERATE_JOIN.note: unset: find the coordinator over mDNS

DERATE_LLAMACPP_IMAGE.note: the CPU runtime's image; the default is a CPU build, so a CUDA llama.cpp tag has to be named here to be used

DERATE_LOG_DIR.note: where node.log, proxy.log and audit/ are written; unset means <data dir>/logs, which is on the volume and survives docker rm

DERATE_LOG_FILES.note: 0 to write no files at all -- stderr and the telemetry journal are unaffected either way

DERATE_MODEL_DIRS.note: colon-separated directories a local model path may resolve under, beside the HF cache and the data dir; anything else is refused

DERATE_NCCL_AUTOCALIBRATE.note: 0 stops a link measurement also calibrating a never-calibrated pair. Calibration costs one two-rank collective per candidate setting and runs only when nothing is stored for that pair and image, so it is once per pair per image rather than per measurement

DERATE_NCCL_ENV.note: NAME=VALUE,... rendered into a multi-rank launch's recipe env: block. Every name is checked against the image's own NCCL_TUNABLES first, because NCCL ignores an unknown one silently. No default on purpose: nothing has measured a collective on this fabric, and NCCL already picks a protocol by message size. See tests/nccl_sweep.py

DERATE_NCCL_MASTER.note: rendezvous address for the two-rank collective harness

DERATE_NCCL_PORT.note: rendezvous port for the same; not a served port

DERATE_OFFLINE.note: answer from cache and fixtures, never reach the network

DERATE_PORT.note: the coordinator's HTTP port; DEFAULT_COORDINATOR_PORT is the same number

DERATE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN.note: the origin browsers use when a TLS terminator fronts the gateway, e.g. https://derate.example; drives the cookie's Secure flag and CSRF

DERATE_REQUESTS_RETENTION_DAYS.note: days the archive keeps requests and access rows; not scaled by DERATE_TELEMETRY_RETENTION_DAYS

DERATE_RESOLVER_TTL.note: seconds; a pinned commit sha never expires whatever this says

DERATE_ROLE.note: auto | coordinator | worker; auto becomes coordinator when none is found

DERATE_SHELL_SESSION.note: set by the server into the session it spawns; not operator-facing

DERATE_SPARKRUN_BIN.note: unset: whatever `sparkrun` resolves to on PATH

DERATE_TELEMETRY.note: 0 switches metrics, events and log capture off; /v1 request rows and access rows are evidence and are still recorded

DERATE_TEST_AUDIO.note: cache the tts runtime's reference clip here, so rerunning the transcription half does not launch the speech model again

DERATE_TEST_NETWORK.note: opt in to tests that reach HuggingFace

DERATE_TOKEN.note: unset: the coordinator generates one and persists it

DERATE_TRUSTED_PROXIES.note: comma-separated IPs/CIDRs allowed to set X-Forwarded-For/-Proto; empty = proxy headers ignored and the peer address is the client

DERATE_TTS_API_KEY.note: set by the recipe: the bearer the tts runtime requires on /v1; unset means the runtime answers unauthenticated

DERATE_TTS_DEFAULT_VOICES.note: 0 leaves an empty voice directory empty instead of fetching a starter library

DERATE_TTS_VOICE_DIR.note: read inside the model container, not on the node

DERATE_UI_DIR.note: the built UI to serve; absent means the API answers and no screen does

DERATE_VLLM_IMAGE_AMD64.note: the vllm image for an x86 (amd64) machine; DERATE_VLLM_IMAGE is the arm64 one the DGX Sparks run
